one_line: Rival rulers at the Devagiri raid of 1296 CE, where a daring Delhi prince forced the Deccan Yadava king into a tributary submission.

appearance.age_look: Alauddin appears late 20s, lean and battle-hardened; Ramachandra appears late 40s to early 50s, solid and regal.
appearance.face: Alauddin has an oval face, wheatish complexion, sharp nose, trimmed moustache with short beard along the jawline, and intense narrow eyes with a focused, calculating default expression; Ramachandra has a broader face, medium brown complexion, strong nose, well-groomed full moustache and short beard, thoughtful eyes and a calm but proud default expression.
appearance.hair: Alauddin’s black hair is medium length and tucked under a dark quilted war-turban with a slightly pointed crown and a narrow metal brow-band; Ramachandra’s dark hair is shoulder-length, wavy, parted at the center, and mostly hidden under a simple golden cloth turban with a small central jewel.
appearance.costume: Alauddin wears a dark forest-green quilted cotton coat (amir’s qaba) to mid-thigh, front-opening and belted, with narrow off-white churidar trousers and a long-sleeved mail shirt peeking at the cuffs and hem; over his shoulders sits a plain steel lamellar vest, and on his feet are pointed brown leather boots; a deep red wool sash wraps his waist, holding a small pouch; Ramachandra wears a long, ankle-length cotton angarkha-style robe in muted saffron with a wrapped front and side tie, over a white dhoti-style lower garment and fitted short-sleeve under-tunic; his angarkha hem and sleeve edges have a narrow dark-red woven border, he has a simple silk sash in dull green at his waist, and he is barefoot in leather sandals; both are modestly and fully covered in era-accurate clothing with no exposed torso.
appearance.signature: Alauddin carries a slightly curved, single-edged Indo-Turkic talwar in a plain steel finish with a simple cross-guard and brown leather scabbard hanging from his red sash, while Ramachandra holds a polished wooden royal staff (danda) about chest-high, with a metal-capped top and subtle floral carving.

ref_desc: Alauddin Khalji is a lean, late-20s warrior with a wheatish oval face, black hair under a dark green quilted war-turban, forest-green quilted qaba over mail, off-white churidar and brown boots, wielding a plain steel talwar with red sash accents, while Ramachandra Yadava is a sturdier, late-40s king with a medium-brown broad face, wavy shoulder-length dark hair under a simple golden turban, wearing a muted saffron angarkha with red borders over a white dhoti and green sash, holding a carved wooden staff with a metal cap; both are fully and modestly clothed in era-accurate garments using forest green, deep red, muted saffron, white and brown leather tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two historically grounded Indian figures from 1296 CE Devagiri: Alauddin Khalji and Ramachandra Yadava. Alauddin stands lean and alert, late 20s, with an oval wheatish face, sharp nose, trimmed moustache and jawline beard, intense narrow eyes and a focused expression; his medium-length black hair is tucked under a dark forest-green quilted war-turban with a slightly pointed crown and narrow metal brow-band. He wears a forest-green quilted cotton qaba to mid-thigh, front-opening and belted, over a long-sleeved mail shirt that shows at the cuffs and hem, off-white churidar trousers, and a plain steel lamellar vest over his torso, all fully covering him; his feet have pointed brown leather boots. A deep red wool sash wraps his waist, holding a brown leather scabbard and small pouch, and he carries a slightly curved plain steel talwar with simple cross-guard as his signature weapon. Beside him, Ramachandra Yadava stands dignified and solid, late 40s to early 50s, medium-brown broad face with strong nose, full moustache and short beard, thoughtful eyes and a calm yet proud expression; his wavy dark hair falls to the shoulders and is mostly covered by a simple golden cloth turban with a small central jewel. He wears an ankle-length muted saffron cotton angarkha with a wrapped front and side tie, narrow dark-red woven hem and sleeve borders, over a white dhoti-style lower garment and a plain fitted under-tunic, with a dull green silk sash at his waist; he is fully and modestly clothed, wearing leather sandals. His signature prop is a polished wooden royal staff (danda) about chest-high with a metal-capped top and subtle floral carving. Emphasize shonen-anime proportions and clean linework while keeping the costumes and weapons historically plausible, and use a colour palette dominated by forest green, deep red, muted saffron, white and brown leather tones, showing both figures head-to-toe in neutral poses suitable for consistent redrawing.
